messages: #p305# asked for my help one last time, this time to hunt #r200 #o38#s#k and collect #b200 #t4000033#s#k. Does she really need THIS many? Is it working?

I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b200 #t4000033#s#k for #p305#. In return, she gave me a nice hat. I collected so many dolls for her, but it seemed like the #o38#s aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... I wonder what was going on. However, it seemed that the fairies might not have as much animosity toward humans now... That's a good thing, at least.
name: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls
